name: Aging and Disability Services
description: San Mateo County Aging and Disability Services (formerly Aging and Adult Services) provides protective services, in-home care, case management, and nutrition programs to help older adults and people with disabilities live safely and independently. It is also the county's Area Agency on Aging.
fullDescription: San Mateo County Aging and Disability Services (formerly Aging and Adult Services) provides protective services, in-home care, case management, and nutrition programs to help older adults and people with disabilities live safely and independently. It is also the county's Area Agency on Aging.
whatTheyOffer:
- Adult Protective Services (abuse prevention and 24-hour emergency response)
- In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS)
- Public Guardian/Conservator services
- Group dining sites and home-delivered meals for older adults
- Case management (Linkages, CalAIM Enhanced Care Management)
- Information and referral through the Aging and Disability Resource Connection (ADRC)
howToGetIt: Call the Aging and Disability Resource Connection at 888-762-2372 for information and referrals, or the main office at (650) 573-3900. To report abuse or get 24-hour emergency response, call the Aging and Disability Services Hotline at 1-844-868-0938 (711 for TDD). Services are for older adults and adults with disabilities.
